entities.summary: Oleksiy Chernyshov is a Ukrainian politician and entrepreneur who most recently served as the Deputy Prime Minister of Ukraine — Minister for National Unity of Ukraine from December 2024 to July 2025. In July 2025, his ministry was merged with the Ministry of Social Policy of Ukraine.
